technical.summary: Strong bullish technicals with multiple trend confirmations (price above all major MAs, supertrend, Ichimoku) but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 82.25, Stoch 98.11) without fresh momentum crossovers create elevated pullback risk; moderate swing entry with caution on exhaustion.

fundamental.summary: CPRT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 37 days creating near-term event risk.

sentiment.summary: Consistent congressional selling by Ro Khanna over 110 days combined with market fear (44 Fear/Greed score) and bearish sentiment (40% bearish) creates a weak bearish signal, though lack of senior/large-scale activity and unavailable news limits conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (348.8) indicates extreme market stress, and credit spreads are widening; earnings in 37 days adds event risk but is not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical confluence (price above all major MAs, supertrend bullish, Ichimoku above cloud, three white soldiers, new 20-day high) provides structural uptrend confirmation for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 82.25, Stoch 98.11) without fresh momentum crossovers, combined with severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, widening credit spreads), zero fundamental support, and congressional insider selling create exhaustion risk in a recessionary environment.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows strong trend structure with price above all major MAs and supertrend confirmation, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 82.25, Stoch 98.11) without fresh momentum crossovers signal exhaustion risk rather than fresh entry opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, widening credit spreads) combined with zero fundamental support and congressional insider selling create high probability of pullback into earnings event in 37 days.
decision.recommended_exit: If forced to enter despite skip recommendation: atr_trail_1x with hard stop at recent swing low to limit downside in recessionary environment.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical overbought, fundamentals weak, sentiment bearish, macro unfavourable, insider selling
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding CPRT with 66 existing Industrials positions (17.6% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further; skip preserves dry powder for higher-conviction setups.
